null-maiden-rhino.name: Null Maiden Rhino
null-maiden-rhino.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly SISTERS OF SILENCE INFANTRY models.

inquisition-land-raider-prometheus.name: Inquisition Land Raider Prometheus
inquisition-land-raider-prometheus.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly ORDO XENOS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models.

prosecution-protocols.name: Prosecution Protocols
prosecution-protocols.text: This unit [does] not suffer the penalty for attacks made with ranged weapons that target obscured PSYKER units.

deadshot.name: Deadshot
deadshot.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons by this unit that target CHARACTER units.

polymorphine.name: Polymorphine
polymorphine.text: When this unit uses the Deep Strike ability, you can set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than D6+3" away from any enemy units, instead of 9".

reign-of-confusion.name: Reign of Confusion
reign-of-confusion.text: If you have any CALLIDUS ASSASSINS in your army, then during the first turn your opponent generates one fewer Command Asset card than they normally would.

bio-meltdown.name: Bio-meltdown
bio-meltdown.text: In the Damage phase, damage must be resolved for units with this ability before damage is resolved for any other units (including SUPER-HEAVY units). If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a D12 for each other LIGHT unit within 3" of this unit; on a 9+ place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

psychic-assassin.name: Psychic Assassin
psychic-assassin.text: This unit [does] not suffer the penalty for attacks made with ranged weapons that target obscured PSYKER units.

malus-codicium.name: Malus Codicium
malus-codicium.text: After this unit is set up on the battlefield for the first time, you can select one friendly DAEMONHOST unit from this unit’s Detachment; add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that DAEMONHOST unit whilst it is within 6" of this unit.

spy-network.name: Spy Network
spy-network.text: Whilst this unit is on the battlefield, increase the number of Command Asset cards you can have in your hand by 1.

loyal-servant.name: Loyal Servant
loyal-servant.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly ORDO HERETICUS INQUISITOR unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that INQUISITOR unit and place them next to this unit.

loyal-servant-2.name: Loyal Servant
loyal-servant-2.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly ORDO MALLEUS INQUISITOR unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that INQUISITOR unit and place them next to this unit.

loyal-servant-3.name: Loyal Servant
loyal-servant-3.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly ORDO XENOS INQUISITOR unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that INQUISITOR unit and place them next to this unit.

daemonic-power.name: Daemonic Power
daemonic-power.text: When you select this unit’s Detachment to carry out its order, but before any units in that Detachment make an action (excluding free actions) that phase, roll one D3, and apply the result from the following table.

1-daemonic-speed.name: 1 - Daemonic Speed
1-daemonic-speed.text: Until the end of the turn, this unit has a Move characteristic of 12" and has the FLY keyword.

2-re-knit-host-form.name: 2 - Re-knit Host Form
2-re-knit-host-form.text: Remove one small blast marker from this unit.

3-energy-torrent.name: 3 - Energy Torrent
3-energy-torrent.text: Until the end of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with ranged weapons by this unit.

inconceivable-customisation.name: Inconceivable Customisation
inconceivable-customisation.text: After this unit makes a Move action, select one friendly ORDO HERETICUS unit within 3" of this unit and roll a D3. Apply the result from the following table to that unit until the end of the turn.

inconceivable-customisation-2.name: Inconceivable Customisation
inconceivable-customisation-2.text: After this unit makes a Move action, select one friendly ORDO MALLEUS unit within 3" of this unit and roll a D3. Apply the result from the following table to that unit until the end of the turn.

inconceivable-customisation-3.name: Inconceivable Customisation
inconceivable-customisation-3.text: After this unit makes a Move action, select one friendly ORDO XENOS unit within 3" of this unit and roll a D3. Apply the result from the following table to that unit until the end of the turn.

1-augmented-targeting.name: 1 - Augmented Targeting
1-augmented-targeting.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by this unit.

2-augmented-penetration.name: 2 - Augmented Penetration
2-augmented-penetration.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made by this unit.

3-the-works.name: 3 - The Works
3-the-works.text: You can re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by this unit.

sanastasia-minst.name: Sanastasia Minst
sanastasia-minst.text: At the start of each Action phase, you can remove one damage marker from this unit.

larsen-van-der-grauss.name: Larsen van der Grauss
larsen-van-der-grauss.text: Re-roll saving throws of 1 made for this unit.

multi-spectral-auspicator.name: Multi-spectral Auspicator
multi-spectral-auspicator.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 made for friendly ELUCIDIAN STARSTRIDERS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

multi-spectral-auspicator-2.name: Multi-spectral Auspicator
multi-spectral-auspicator-2.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 made for this unit.

battle-auspex.name: Battle Auspex
battle-auspex.text: This unit does not suffer the penalty for attacks made with ranged weapons that target obscured targets.

paralysis-grenades.name: Paralysis Grenades
paralysis-grenades.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units that target this unit.

psychic-abomination.name: Psychic Abomination
psychic-abomination.text: This unit cannot be targeted or affected by Command Assets that are psychic powers, or weapons with the Witchfire ability. PSYKER units within 6" of this unit cannot be selected to manifest psychic powers.

independent-operative.name: Independent Operative
independent-operative.text: This unit cannot be a WARLORD.

authority-of-the-inquisition.name: Authority of the Inquisition
authority-of-the-inquisition.text: This unit can embark aboard any IMPERIUM TRANSPORT, even though the transport in question might normally only permit models with other Faction keywords to do so. All other restrictions apply normally.

unquestionable-wisdom.name: Unquestionable Wisdom
unquestionable-wisdom.text: Friendly IMPERIUM units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

warrant-of-trade.name: Warrant of Trade
warrant-of-trade.text: This unit can embark aboard any IMPERIUM TRANSPORT, even though the transport in question might normally only permit models with other Faction keywords to do so. All other restrictions apply normally.
